messages:
Reza: quick sync 1: I want to pilot a 'preview cohort' flow in service-config so product teams can test runtime flags without full rollouts. tossing up design + ops questions.
Lina: sounds good. high level: cohort assignation, TTL, per-route opt-outs, and console visibility?
Reza: exactly. proposal: cohort-based sampling with an assign id, default ttl=1h, cohorts start tiny (0.05%) and ramp if clean.
Theo: add route-sensitivity. critical routes (auth/payment) should default to opt-out unless explicitly allowed. we can't risk even tiny exposure there.
Reza: agreed. config example we'll serve via config API: ```yaml
preview:
  enabled: true
  cohort_rate: 0.0005
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  allow_critical_routes: false
```
Lina: console needs three things: live exposure count, recent sampled requests, and an emergency "pause cohort" CTA that annotates audit logs. also make cohort id visible to callers for debugging.
DesignBot: mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/preview-cohort-mock (shows expandable sample list + one-click rollback).
Theo: on telemetry: emit preview.cohort.assigns, preview.cohort.errors, preview.latency.delta. Set auto-pause rule: errors > 0.75% OR p95_delta > 40ms over 5m. Auto-pause should create a ticket and ping #release-war-room.
Reza: +1. also want a "soft-announce" banner to product teams affected with a link to opt-out.
Lina: small API detail 1: include preview_meta in responses when applicable so clients can log cohort_id. sample response: ```json
{"data": {...}, "preview_meta": {"cohort_id": "pc-7f2", "assigned_at": 1759999990}}
```
Theo: retention question: how long do we keep sample logs? we should keep raw samples for 24h and aggregated telemetry for 90d.
Reza: agree. make retention configurable per-team but default to those windows.
Lina: compatibility note 1: we have old "beta_preview" flags in some repos. need a migration adaptor in API layer that maps old->new fields in responses and admin UI.
Reza: will open a PR for the migration adapter + unit tests. I'll also add a console feature flag to gate the UI until we flip.
ops-bot: scheduled staging run job id: preview-dryrun-1759999990. streaming preview metrics to staging telemetry.
Theo: can ops-bot add a quick healthcheck that simulates 10k requests and validates no SLO regressions?
ops-bot: healthcheck queued. result in ~8m.
ops-bot: healthcheck complete: 10k synthetic reqs, preview.errors=0.03%, p95_delta=+5ms. no auto-pause triggered.
Lina: great. next step: enable 0.5% for non-critical routes tomorrow and monitor for 48h before wider lift.
Reza: plan set. tagging: @Lina @Theo for console + telemetry follow-ups. thanks all. :rocket:
